newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt office auctions 7.2 bln SKR T-Bills.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt office auctions 7.2 bln SKR T-Bills.

text.p: An auction of Treasury bills worth 7.2 billion crowns was over-subscribed, Sweden's National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate on six-month T-bills was 5.13 percent while the average accepted rate on one-year bills was 5.31 percent, the debt office said.

The office had invited bids for a total of 2.4 billion crowns of six-month bills and 4.8 billion crowns for one-year paper. It received bids for 5.31 billion crowns and 7.18 billion crowns respectively.
